scope: development only; no training; no test-set tuning

existing_endpoints.0: TCG B+1500 matched-FP32 baseline, not original GVC-RT

first_stage.engineering_checks: Matched full-sequence smoke at gains 0 and 1 before endpoint reuse; all 5 LoRA branches scaled; original weights and TCG unchanged; reset temporal buffers and decode complete 64-frame sequence at each gain; identical streams, RGB conversion and metric weights

scale_definition: extra gain s times existing (LoRA alpha/r)=1; keep rank=4 and intrinsic alpha=4; use s=0.5, not alpha=0.5
qp_definition: Use one gain for the full P-frame sequence at external QP9; do not alternate gain according to inherited actual frame QP9/10/11 in this first probe; deployment lookup must use decoder-known rate setting, not external hidden metadata
interpretation: An intermediate point that dominates gain1 supports excessive full-strength adaptation on the development set. Reduced DISTS cost alone, with proportional FloLPIPS loss, only shows a tradeoff. One QP cannot establish QP-specific causality.
followup_if_supported: Evaluate the same gain0.5 at QP0/5 on the same 32 development videos before preferring QP-specific gain to a common global gain; preregister selection rule and then use untouched source-group-isolated confirmation data
